summary: Royal Bank of Canada filed a Form 6-K containing its interim unaudited financial statements for the quarter ended April 30, 2026. This is a routine periodic report submitted by a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, with no disclosure of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing consists entirely of standard financial tables and risk disclosures. As such, it does not qualify as a special-situation event.
